postal_system.legal_rule: The Ministry of Science and Technology national portal and Decision 2334/QD-BKHCN update five-character assignments for wards, communes and equivalent units under the 2025 two-tier administration. Vietnam Post confirms the transition. The UPU sheet documents five digits and home, rural, building-complex, post-office and special-delivery formats, but predates the reform. These sources establish syntax, dated assignments, address order and routing objects, not canonical polygons, exact civic addresses, building relations, complete history or blanket redistribution rights.
postal_system.assignment_rule: Every postcode is stored as a five-character digit string with leading zeroes preserved. A production assignment requires an exact current national-portal or Decision 2334 row, authority, administrative identifier, validity, retrieval time and source digest pinned. NSO current-to-former crosswalks may retain legacy district context only. Prefixes, equal names, Vpostcode lookups, office points, coordinates, administrative overlap and nearest features do not create a postal assignment, postal area or delivery entitlement.
postal_system.geometry_rule: No reviewed canonical national Vietnam postcode polygon artifact is bundled. An official postal surface requires an exact postal-authority boundary artifact and code relation with authority, edition, coverage, rights, CRS, topology and digest pinned. Joining a current official postcode assignment to an NSO or NSDI administrative boundary is a source-composed administrative join surface, not a postal-authority polygon. Voronoi, interpolation and model surfaces remain derived and uncertainty-bearing; districts, wards, communes, Vpostcode points, NSDI layers, map products and OSM never become official postcode polygons.
postal_system.address_rule: Recipient, organization, apartment, floor, room, building or complex, house number, alley, lane, street, village or hamlet, residential group, ward or commune, province or centrally governed city, legacy district, P.O. box or post office and five-digit postcode remain typed and validity-aware. A postcode, administrative row, digital-address code, parcel, coordinate or map label alone does not identify a recipient, owner, occupant, entrance, unit or exact legal civic address.
postal_system.building_rule: Exact building display requires an explicit rights-cleared civic or digital-address identifier, separately permitted building geometry, and a provider-defined stable relation, common identifier or reviewed explicit crosswalk. Vpostcode points, NSDI and official map buildings, cadastral parcels, address strings, administrative containment, coordinate equality, proximity and nearest-building logic are candidates or validation evidence only and never establish an exact address-building relation.
postal_system.licence_rule: National postcode, Decision 2334, Vietnam Post, UPU and NSO pages are reference evidence until exact reuse terms are recorded. Vpostcode queries and APIs require exact service and output terms. NSDI access can require registration, and surveying and mapping products use request, fee, state-secret and product-specific controls. Viewing, searching, downloading, registering, requesting, paying or attributing never grants blanket row, map, address or building redistribution rights.
postal_system.privacy_rule: Recipients, senders, P.O. box holders, Vpostcode account or query records, phones, emails, identity data, households, residents, owners, occupants, tenants, parcel-right holders, cadastral records, access credentials, tracking records and private premises are excluded from public artifacts. Only explicitly public or licensed non-personal fields may enter a production pack.

stages.definition: Contracts and synthetic conformance fixtures are reviewable.

A current complete-for-declared-coverage Vietnam five-digit assignment and exact permitted Polygon/MultiPolygon artifact pin code-to-area semantics, jurisdiction, validity, CRS, schema, topology, terms, edition and SHA-256. An approved immutable artifact is loaded by the VN runtime/API and verified in the app through normalized search, loading/not-found/multiple/API-failure/invalid/non-area states, fit, translucent fill, clear outline, clear/re-search and visible official/derived/virtual authority, source, basis date and confidence. Administrative-unit assignments or borders, office and Vpostcode points, buffers, Voronoi cells and models never become official postal areas; point, route, P.O. box, organization and unknown codes are not forced into polygons; house numbers and buildings require separate explicit permitted stable relations. Synthetic fixtures, shared UI code or a text-only portal never establish M2.
Rights-cleared current civic or digital-address identifiers and explicit address membership pass currency, exception, privacy, completeness and provenance gates.
Derived postal geometry and exact permitted address-building joins pass topology, ambiguity, identifier, privacy and quality gates.
